description: Create up to 25 posts in one call. Each post is saved as a draft; a post with scheduledDateTime is then scheduled for publishing to its platform, which requires a plan that includes scheduling. If the workspace requires approval, a dated post is submitted for approval instead (status PENDING_APPROVAL) and an owner/admin must approve it in Postel. Posts are processed in order with one result each, so some can succeed while others fail. At most 25 media URLs per call.

firstComment.description: LinkedIn only: comment posted under the post right after it is published. Max 1250 characters.

mediaUrls.description: Public image or video URLs to download and attach (max 4). X: up to 4 images, or one video or GIF. LinkedIn: images, or one video.

items.description: Public http(s) URL of an image or video

scheduledDateTime.description: UTC ISO-8601 time to publish (must be in the future). Omit to keep the post as a draft

name: create-posts
title: Create posts in bulk
